description: Additional authored development cases for source selection: different values and entities, negation, similar codes and two-part questions. Not a held-out benchmark.

pages.text: Lantern Kits dispatches standard orders within 9 business days. Lantern Kits accepts returns only with the original receipt.
Lantern Kits diagnostics. The code BT-306 indicates a battery fault. The different code BT-360 indicates a pressure sensor fault.
Basalt Studio stores project files for 24 months. Basalt Studio does not email backups to customers. Dr. Chen approves onsite access requests.
Summit Kits dispatches standard orders within 6 calendar days. Summit Kits accepts returns only with written authorization from the store manager.
